description: Using Multiecuscan diagnostic software, analyze the Body Computer configuration of a Fiat 500. In simulation mode: (1) Navigate to Fiat > 500 > Body system and select the Body Computer module, (2) Start simulation, (3) Read the ECU identification, (4) Check for any body-related DTCs (door sensors, lighting, comfort systems), (5) Explore the available vehicle configuration and adjustment settings, (6) Document all available configurable items you can find, (7) Create a comprehensive Body Computer analysis report at C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\MultiecuscanTasks\body_computer_report.txt that includes: ECU identification, body DTCs found (with descriptions from DTC database), a complete list of available adjustment categories and their current values, and recommendations for common configuration changes that vehicle owners typically request. Cross-reference body-related DTCs (B-codes) with the DTC database.
natural_language: Analyze the Body Computer of a Fiat 500 in Multiecuscan simulation mode. Read ECU info, body DTCs, and document all available configuration/adjustment settings with their current values.
